name: Star Battle
description: Anime fighting with the Battle Mask: activate it to enter Battle Mode. 12 fighting styles (Blade, Martial, Ki, Shadow, Thunder, Mirage, Celestial, Cosmic, Abyss, Cipher, Lancer, Rift), a four-hit basic attack chain for each, 36 skills with cinematic ultimates, the Abyss Beast Mode and five style slots.
